answer: Make payout weight something a key must win over the board. Each epoch a VRF pairs every key with 6 established opponents from other funding clusters; weight follows a Glicko rating that starts at zero and rises only on wins against those assigned strangers. A new key needs ~40 rated games (~12 GPU-hours of live play) before it earns, so 100 sybils cost ~1,200 GPU-hours. A farm cannot wander off to a quiet knoll of weak friends and call it a haven: pairings are drawn, not chosen. Failure mode: thrown games, caught when a key's losses cluster on one opponent beyond 3 sigma.
